lines.text: Two days before the Passover, the chief priests and scribes sought a covert way to arrest Jesus, but not during the feast.
In the home of Simon the Leper in Jericho, a woman broke open an alabaster jar of perfume and poured it on Jesus' head.
Some present were indignant and scolded her, saying the perfume could have been sold for over three hundred denarii and given to the poor.
Jesus said she had anointed His body in advance of His burial, and her deed would be told in memory of her.
Judas Iscariot went to the chief priests to betray Jesus, and they were delighted and promised to give him land.
